answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 13364 Country: India Title: four persons present at same place; Zaid,Salma,Junaid and Sauda. Junaid asked Salma that do u accept Zaid in your nikah, Salma answered Yes.Then Junaid asked Zaid that do u accept Salma in your nikah, Zaid also answered Yes. So,is this nikah valid ? Is Zaid and Salma both are husband and wife now ? If yes, then how ? If no, then how ? plz reply as soon as possible... Jazakallahu khaira wa ahsan al jaza wassalamualaykum wr wb Question: four persons present at same place; Zaid,Salma,Junaid and Sauda. Junaid asked Salma that do u accept Zaid in your nikah, Salma answered Yes.Then Junaid asked Zaid that do u accept Salma in your nikah, Zaid also answered Yes. So,is this nikah valid ? Is Zaid and Salma both are husband and wife now ? If yes, then how ? If no, then how ? plz reply as soon as possible... Jazakallahu khaira wa ahsan al jaza wassalamualaykum wr wb Answer ID: 13364 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1018/972=H/1430) Neither the Nikah was valid nor are they husband and wife. The reason is that the witness is incomplete. Moreover, this way of Nikah is extremely abhorring and undesirable, it must be avoided. This will cause evils and the society will develop immoralities. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
